The autonomy gain function models how information entropy translates into operational independence, with conversion and cost metrics as key regulators. Observability is encoded as a scalar measure of workflow clarity and manual overhead. These primitives form a closed-loop system where telemetry informs decision-making, and decisions influence future telemetry. Failure modes include data drift, overfitting to historical patterns, and misalignment between internal observability and user-facing signals. The dashboard must remain agnostic to production data to avoid contamination of the learning process.
